subject.why: Clearly depicts two pink pillar candles with gently glowing flames and carved heart details as requested.

category.why: The candles rest on a flat, solid-colour surface with a plain, smoothly gradated vertical wall behind them, matching Category 2 rules.

clean.why: No text, UI, borders, logos, or characters present.

framing.why: The candles are centrally framed as a cohesive unit with generous margins on all sides.

colour.why: Saturated and bright palette; the pink candles separate clearly from the vibrant purple background.

detail.why: Clean surfaces with no noisy micro-textures, scratches, or unnecessary extra props.

style.why: Rendered with smooth, chunky volumes, a soft satin sheen, and no harsh outlines, consistent with the reference style.
